title: Metformin label: adult clinical study
text: A 29-week double-blind, placebo-controlled multicenter trial studied obese adults with type 2 diabetes inadequately controlled by dietary management. Metformin (141 participants) reduced HbA1c by 1.4 percentage points; placebo (145 participants) increased HbA1c by 0.4 percentage points. This study does not establish long-term outcomes.

title: Metformin label: risks and adverse reactions
text: Postmarketing metformin-associated lactic acidosis cases have resulted in death. Metformin may lower vitamin B12 levels. Common adverse reactions include diarrhea, nausea/vomiting, flatulence, asthenia, indigestion, abdominal discomfort, and headache.

title: Metformin label: drug interactions
text: Carbonic anhydrase inhibitors, including topiramate, may increase lactic acidosis risk with metformin. Cimetidine and dolutegravir can reduce metformin clearance and increase accumulation. Alcohol can potentiate metformin effects on lactate metabolism.

title: Metformin label: contraindications
text: Label contraindications include severe renal impairment (eGFR below 30 mL/min/1.73 m2), hypersensitivity to metformin, and acute or chronic metabolic acidosis, including diabetic ketoacidosis.
